<summary>📝 Walkthrough</summary>

## Walkthrough

`OAuthConfig` in `osin/v1/types.go` gains a new optional `ProxyTrustedCA` field. It is serialized as `proxyTrustedCA`, limited to 512 characters, and documented as a PEM-encoded CA bundle path for verifying HTTPS proxy connections during outbound IdP requests. Empty values use the system trust roots.

**Suggested reviewers:** `JoelSpeed`
